features.name: Scenario list + sample title
features.description: The app shows the 'Compression' sample title and a scenario list containing '1) Compression/Decompression sample', which is selected on launch.
expected_behaviour: Scenario list contains the item '1) Compression/Decompression sample'
That scenario is selected and its page is shown on launch

features.name: Default algorithm description on load
features.description: On load the DefaultTextBlock is visible showing 'DEFAULT: No compression algorithms explicitly specified. Xpress is used by default.'; all other algorithm descriptions are collapsed.
expected_behaviour: The DEFAULT description text is visible on initial load

features.name: Algorithm ComboBox
features.description: A ComboBox (CompressAlgorithmComboBox) offers 5 items: Default, Xpress, XpressHuff, Mszip, Lzms, with 'Default' selected (SelectedIndex=0).
expected_behaviour: ComboBox shows 'Default' as the selected value on load
Opening the ComboBox lists Default, Xpress, XpressHuff, Mszip, Lzms

features.name: Description switches with algorithm selection
features.description: SelectionChanged shows the description TextBlock for the newly selected algorithm and collapses the previously selected one.
expected_behaviour: Selecting 'Xpress' shows the XPRESS description and hides the DEFAULT one
Each algorithm selection reveals only its matching description text

features.name: Compress File... button opens file picker
features.description: Clicking 'Compress File...' (CompressFileButton) invokes DoScenario, which opens a FileOpenPicker (all file types) to select an input file.
expected_behaviour: A 'Compress File...' button is present next to the ComboBox
Clicking it opens a single-file open picker with a '*' (All files) filter

features.name: Compress + decompress with progress log
features.description: After a file is picked, the app compresses it with the selected algorithm, then decompresses it, writing a step-by-step log into the Progress TextBlock (picked / created / streams wired / bytes compressed / bytes decompressed).
expected_behaviour: Progress text reports the picked file name
Progress text reports compressed byte count and decompressed byte count
Progress log matches the UWP sequence of messages

features.name: Status bar notifications
features.description: The shared status area (NotifyUser) shows 'Working...' during the operation and 'All done' on success, or the error message on failure.
expected_behaviour: Status shows 'Working...' when the operation starts
Status shows 'All done' after a successful compress/decompress
Errors (e.g. cancelled picker) surface as an error status message
